sources.title: Hugging Face's $399 Microduck Robot Learns to Walk | Santage
sources.snippet: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics launched Microduck, a $399 open-source bipedal robot that trains its own walking policy with reinforcement learning in under two hours.

Microduck · From body to behavior
sources.snippet: A walking robot cannot succeed through one model alone. Its body must carry loads, its sensors must estimate motion, its software must coordinate devices, and its controller must turn a requested movement into safe joint targets. sources.title: Hugging Face Releases Programmable, Walking Duck Robot
sources.snippet: Hugging Face is expanding its push into physical AI, with its new programmable robot shaped like a tiny duck. The open source AI company unveiled the $399 Microduck, a small-scale robot that can be programmed to perform a range of behaviors, including walking, picking up objects and recovering after a fall.
